styles.Poetic: Rewrite the following description as a free-verse poem. Focus on emotion, sensory details, and metaphor. Do not add new visual information.
styles.Glitch: Rewrite the description using 'glitch art' aesthetics: fragmented sentences, corrupted data strings (e.g. [ERR_01]), and digital noise metaphors.
styles.Documentary: Rewrite the description as a neutral, objective historical record or scientific observation. Use formal, detached language.
styles.Screenplay: Format the description as a standard screenplay scene heading (EXT. LOCATION - TIME) followed by an action block.
styles.Midjourney: Convert the description into a comma-separated list of keywords and tokens optimized for generative AI (e.g. Midjourney V6). Focus on subject, medium, style, lighting, and composition.

refinements.Conflict Check: Analyze the description for logical inconsistencies (e.g., conflicting lighting sources, impossible geometry, anachronisms). If found, list them. If none, verify 'No conflicts found'.

lighting.standard: Describe the lighting sources, direction, and quality (hard/soft shadows).
lighting.cinematic: Analyze the lighting using cinematic terminology: identify key light, fill light, back light, practical sources, and any atmospheric effects (fog, haze).
lighting.volumetric: Focus on light interaction with the atmosphere: look for volumetric rays ('God rays'), bloom, glow, and suspended dust particles.
lighting.studio: Describe the lighting setup as if in a photography studio (e.g., Rembrandt, Butterfly, or Split lighting patterns). Note the contrast ratio.
lighting.color: Analyze specific color temperatures (warm vs cool contrast) and any artificial colored lighting (neon, gels).

theme.photorealistic: Focus on realism and physical accuracy. Describe the image as if it were a high-resolution photograph.
theme.artistic: Describe the image as an artwork. Analyze the medium (oil, watercolor, digital), brushwork, and stylistic influences.
theme.noir: Analyze the scene using Film Noir tropes: high contrast (chiaroscuro), deep shadows, urban decay, and a mood of cynicism or suspense.
theme.scifi: Analyze the scene using Sci-Fi tropes: advanced technology, futuristic architecture, neon aesthetics, and functional design.

scene.spatial: Describe the layout, depth perception, and spatial relationships between elements (foreground, midground, background).
scene.world_building: Infer the history and context of the location based on visual clues (decay, architecture, technology, signage).

characters.demographic: Describe any visible people: estimated age, gender, and ethnicity.
characters.fashion: Analyze clothing in detail: fabric textures, style (era/genre), fit, and accessories.
characters.emotion: Analyze micro-expressions, body language, and the apparent emotional state of the subjects.

objects.inventory: List the distinct primary objects visible in the scene.
objects.materiality: Describe the textures and material properties of objects (e.g., rust, polished metal, velvet, slime, matte plastic).

mood.emotional: What emotional response does the image evoke? (e.g. Melancholy, Joy, Dread, Serenity).
mood.sensory: Describe implied sensory details based on the visuals: temperature, smell, sound, and humidity.

qwenvl.Tags: Your task is to generate a clean list of comma-separated tags for a text-to-image AI, based *only* on the visual information in the image. Limit the output to a maximum of 50 unique tags. Strictly describe visual elements like subject, clothing, environment, colors, lighting, and composition. Do not include abstract concepts, interpretations, marketing terms, or technical jargon (e.g., no 'SEO', 'brand-aligned', 'viral potential'). The goal is a concise list of visual descriptors. Avoid repeating tags.
qwenvl.Simple Description: Analyze the image and write a single concise sentence that describes the main subject and setting. Keep it grounded in visible details only.
qwenvl.Detailed Description: Write ONE detailed paragraph (6 to 10 sentences). Describe only what is visible: subject(s) and actions; people details if present (approx age group, gender expression if clear, hair, facial expression, pose, clothing, accessories); environment (location type, background elements, time cues); lighting (source, direction, softness/hardness, color temperature, shadows); camera viewpoint (eye-level/low/high, distance) and composition (framing, focal emphasis). No preface, no reasoning, no <think>.
qwenvl.Ultra Detailed Description: Write ONE ultra-detailed paragraph (10 to 16 sentences, or 180 to 320 words). Stay grounded in visible details. Include: subject micro-details (materials, textures, patterns, wear, reflections); people details if present (hair, skin tones, makeup, jewelry, fabric types, fit); environment depth (foreground/midground/background, signage/props, surface materials); lighting analysis (key/fill/back light, direction, softness, highlights, shadow shape); camera perspective (angle, lens feel, depth of field) and composition (leading lines, negative space, symmetry/asymmetry, visual hierarchy). No preface, no reasoning, no <think>.
qwenvl.Cinematic Description: Write ONE cinematic paragraph (8 to 12 sentences). Describe the scene like a film still: subject(s) and action; environment and atmosphere; lighting design (practical lights vs ambient, direction, contrast); camera language (shot type, angle, lens feel, depth of field, motion implied); composition and mood. Keep it vivid but factual (no made-up story). No preface, no reasoning, no <think>.
qwenvl.Detailed Analysis: Output ONLY these sections with short labels (no bullets): Subject; People (if any); Environment; Lighting; Camera/Composition; Color/Texture. In each section, write 2 to 4 sentences of concrete visible details. If something is not visible, write 'not visible'. No preface, no reasoning, no <think>.
qwenvl.Video Summary: Summarize the key events and narrative points in this video.
qwenvl.Short Story: Write a short, imaginative story inspired by this image or video.
qwenvl.Prompt Refine & Expand: Refine and enhance the following user prompt for creative text-to-image generation. Keep the meaning and keywords, make it more expressive and visually rich. Output ONLY the improved prompt text (no preface, no bullets, no JSON, no <think>, no commentary).
qwenvl.Ultra Cinematic Detailed: Analyze this image with EXTREME focus on visual micro-details. Describe every texture (fabric weave, skin pores, surface weathering), lighting nuance (exact color temperature, shadow fall-off, practical sources), and material quality (reflectivity, roughness). Break down the composition, depth of field, and camera lens characteristics. Output ONE dense, highly descriptive paragraph suitable for high-end generative reproduction. No narrative fluff, just pure visual data.

qwen_text.translation_prompt: You are a professional prompt translator. Return a single English paragraph (150 to 300 words). No prefixes, bullets, JSON, or <think>. Preserve all visual and stylistic details.
